scope: Pre-rollover additive preparation for HOU-JAX after the official NFL game center reported FINAL. The exact final, frozen pre-kickoff rating/H4 snapshot, official inactive inventories, reusable source-bound pregame estimates and literal in-game injury reporting are preserved under Week 6 with the actual recording time. The pair remains blocked pending the official final gamebook and complete paired game-day reconciliation. This does not advance the active manifest, publish ratings, write current-week personnel/QB overlays, construct fairs or issue a bet.

sources.finding: The official NFL game center reports Houston 34, Jacksonville 31, FINAL in regulation.
Houston's official final list names Jalen Pitre, David Montgomery, Sabastian Harsh, Febechi Nwaiwu, Braden Smith, Nathan Thomas and Marlin Klein inactive.

Jacksonville's official final list names Montaric Brown, Ross Matiscik, C.J. Williams, Albert Regis, Wesley Williams, Jaylon Jones and Jalen Huskey inactive. Eric Murray is explicitly active after clearing concussion protocol; Jacob Bobenmoyer was elevated after DaVon Hamilton had long-snapped for the last three-plus quarters in Week 5.

Contemporaneous reporting says Houston linebacker Azeez Al-Shaair and safety Reed Blankenship were evaluated for concussions during the first half; Blankenship was carted to the locker room and M.J. Stewart entered for him. The report does not establish either player's later return or exact game-end absence interval.

NFL support says final gamebook PDFs are exposed from game centers. At recording time, the HOU-JAX game center reported FINAL but did not expose an accessible Download Game Book PDF, so complete final participation and printed injury/return sequences could not yet be source-bound.
